notes.title: SkyStrikers Spring Update
notes.notes:
Hi Strikers,

We are excited to welcome spring with a jam-packed update full of new features. Check out the details below!

[h2]New Feature Pack - Hiveswarm Bulwarp Pack[/h2]
Bulwarp finally gets some love with the community-inspired bee-themed Hiveswarm Pack, available on March 7th for 2538 JC

[h2]Follow System - Find Your Fellow Strikers Right Away[/h2]
Want to join your friends or fellow strikers in the same hub or custom game without asking offline? Introducing the Follow System! You can follow your friend in LOBBY app then you can see when they are online and which server they are in inside SOCIAL app on WPad.

[h2]Custom Server - Upgraded Custom Game[/h2]
We've upgraded our Custom Game feature! When you start a custom game now, you'll launch your own server, ensuring all participants can join the same room. It can host up to 8 players per server, but only 3 players from each team will get post-match results.

[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]
You can now join Custom Games as an invisible spectator. Just type in the game code and hit the "Join as a Spectator" button to roam and observe the match freely. To leave, simply return to the elevator area for 10 seconds.

[h2]Enhanced Bulwarp[/h2]
Bulwarp is receiving several updates to enhance class versatility. More visual info will be available later, but here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Bulwarp portal can now be placed from a far distance.
[*] Bulwarp paddle hit power has been slightly increased.
[*] Bulwarp shield can be deployed immediately after the last deployment at the cost of one energy.
[*] Bulwarp keeps accelerating while sliding on the ground.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
The ball in Heat Seeker mode now has a higher speed cap.
We've increased the JC you can earn from the Daily Login machine; you can now receive JC 3 times per 7-day cycle.

We hope you enjoy these new updates and content!

Happy Gaming,
The SkyStrikers Team

notes.title: Sky Strikers Update EA 1.0 - Ranked MatchMaking
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers

The wait is finally over! The September update has arrived, and we have some HUGE NEWS to share with you. Dive into the details of this jam-packed update below, and don't miss the exciting announcement at the end!

[h2]HALL OF HEROES[/h2]
We've renamed the Arena building the "HALL OF HEROES" and transformed it into a majestic temple honoring Skystrikers' top players. With leaderboards now displaying various in-game stats and showcasing the state leader's statue on top of it.

[h2]RANKED MATCHMAKING[/h2]
We are excited to share that we've brought the competitive play experience in Skystrikers to a whole new level. Ranked matches are now exclusively 3v3, starting in a new locker room where you can switch classes and strategize with your team. The arena itself has been upgraded—it's larger, with a higher ceiling and new energy cell positions. A post-match rating system is also being introduced and it will determine an MVP for each game. You can join ranked matches via the button in the Hall of Heroes, while private matches remain accessible through the code machine.

[h2]NEW STATS SYSTEM[/h2]
From goals, assists, and saves to average air time, ball position percentage, and energy efficiency—we've got all your stats covered. Visit the cloakroom in the shop to explore our comprehensive stat tracking system, which offers insights that cater to every player's interest.

[h2]FREE OG GOOBER AVATAR SET: A Token of Our Appreciation[/h2]
To thank those who supported us from our App Lab days, we are bringing back the OG Goober design and gifting it to all pre-launch players. This exclusive avatar set grants you ultimate OG status in the game.

[h2]MAGEPUNK PRIME BUNDLE: Complete Your OG Look[/h2]
The bundle to complete the OG Goober look. The Magepunk Prime suit is the most elaborate skin we've ever released. Featuring custom animations, specialized visual effects, and sound effects, this bundle will be available with in hours of this update, and it is not to be missed.

[h2]STARTER PACK: New Intro Offer[/h2]
Celebrate the official launch of Skystrikers with our Starter Pack, offering three times the value of a standard JC pack. It includes a Guardian vs Airborne theme bat and avatar head. Available once per account, it's the best way to kickstart your journey.

Thank you all for your support! We could not have come this far without you. And we can't wait to start the next chapter with you! Happy striking!

The Skystrikers Team

notes.title: Sky Strikers major update - Arena 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers! If you followed our progress on Discord, you probably already saw we’ve given our arena a makeover. We're committed to improving each and every aspect of the game while working on the bigger picture. You can play the new Arena now, and let us know what you think. We read ALL of your feedback!

🌟Redesigned Arena with new visual effects. 
🌟More floating platforms added for a wider range of spatial movement options.
🌟Body & head hitboxes no longer interact with the ball to prevent the ball getting stuck in the player and making the close game too random in general.
🌟Max ball speed reduced from 20 to 18. 
🌟Rockets no longer make the ball fly faster than the max speed. 
🌟Equipping the bat will apply a small push force to the ball if the bat intersects the ball. (We call it poking mechanic)
🌟Introduced screens show who scored and clearer match information. 
🌟Small visual updates to the consoles.  
🌟New ball texture and trail.  

Thanks for your patience as you follow us down the road. Thanks so much for all the positive words and support! Anyway, it's time for some matches - update your game now and enjoy the new Arena with your friends! 🚀 

Talk to us on [url=https://discord.gg/vTKM7ySGKR] Discord [/url]

notes.title: Sky Strikers Weekly Patch EA 0.1.6
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers!

Feedback showed that some new players were waiting for the ball to fall down instead of using the map vertically, and it was giving the impression that the ball was not falling fast enough. We tried a build with a heavier ball and it was dreadful. The gameplay is more dynamic when players fly around the map, so we're giving an extra boost to hoist players up a little to encourage more jumping. Below is full changelog for this week.

[list]
[*] Player fall speed reduced to give more reaction time for interaction with platforms and vertical surfaces.
[*] New trail effect added to the ball to visually reward powerful shots and get closer to our target visual style.
[*] Bat power increased for weak swings. Feedback was taken into account to improve medium-range power shots.
[*] Adjusted player head and body collider to be thinner, making it less likely to get stuck when trying to climb or wall jump.
[*] Improved precision of the white circles on the ground that mark the ball's position.
[/list]

Best regards,
Sky Strikers Dev Team

[list]
[*] The movement speed of the player now has an effect on how powerful their hits are on the ball.
[*] The force applied to the ball from a swing is now more inline with the strength of the players swing in the real world.
[*] The maximum speed of the ball has been increased from 10 to 20 to allow for more versatile gameplay with the aforementioned adjustments.
[*] Improved haptic feedback when hitting the ball with the bat.
[*] Added a shiny new texture for the base and Grumble skins.
[*] Improved various visual effects when the ball is hit with the bat on default skin.
[*] Lowered the intensity of the ball's deformation when hit.
[*] Bug fix - Constantly spawning and despawning the bat inside of the ball no longer causes it to fly fast.
[/list]

Best regards,
Sky Strikers Dev Team

notes.notes:
Hello Strikers!

We've been listening to your feedback, and in order to make the game more thrilling and dramatic, we've decided to change the goal rule. From now on, the ball must fully pass through the goal plane to score, instead of just touching it.

Thank you for your continued support.

Best regards,
Sky Strikers Dev Team

notes.title: Sky Strikers Weekly Patch EA 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers!

We encountered a black screen issue earlier today but now we able to identify and temporarily fix the root cause. However, we are committed to providing a better gaming experience for everyone and plan to improve the connection logic next week. Below is a list of the issues that we have addressed so far: 

[list]
[*] A temporary fix for the broken public room which stops player to connect
[*] Added server selection on the room panel
[/list]

Thanks,
Sky Strikers Dev Team

notes.title: Sky Strikers Weekly Patch EA 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers!

We have just released a fix for some visual bugs and made some minor design changes to improve usability. Here's a list of the things we fixed:

[list]
[*] Fixed visual bug where missiles may briefly fly backwards before moving in the correct direction. 
[*] Fixed muzzle flash not visible to remote players
[*] Adjusted the ball indicator to only outside circle become big
[*] Adjusted the match timer above the goals to countdown rather than count up.
[*] Added app version information to the Connection screen.
[/list]

Thanks,
Sky Strikers Dev Team

notes.title: Sky Strikers Weekly Patch EA 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello Strikers!

We just released a fix to improve the game experiences on game settings and modified some visual effect to make them better. Here are the things we fixed:

[list]
[*] Added two muzzle flashes to Frosty.
[*] Added two hit effects to Frosty.
[*] Fixed muzzle flash not showing.
[*] Fixed ball trajectory effect.
[*] Fixed snap turn moving the player's body incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the game options not being saved.
[*] Fixed Frosty skin not correctly loaded sometimes.
[*] Fixed the ball indicators on the scoreboard, which were being rendered to only one eye.
[*] Fixed connection to a full room player not going back to pulic room until restart game.
[/list]

Thanks,
Sky Strikers Dev Team
